messages:
erin: heads-up — after last night's rollout (merge 0f3a9b) production started seeing a spike in OOMs on long-context jobs (> 4096). Appears tied to the KV cache allocator path. filing as rollout blocker :exclamation:

sam: ugh, saw a couple of alerts. CI perf-run also flagged a 20% increase in p99 token latency for the same jobset. any quick bisect pointers?

kevin: I started a quick local repro using the longctx benchmark. reproduces reliably for sequence lengths 6k-12k. attaching pmap + freedump.

kevin: ```
$ pmap $(pgrep runtime) | tail -n 10
7f3c0000-7f3d0000 rw-s 00000000 00:12 123456 /dev/shm/kv-slab
...
Total: 14G
```

rachel: looks like we spiral on allocations in the slow-path when compact-on-evict is enabled. that flag was flipped in PR #4247 for the compacting heuristic on mixed batch sizes.

maria: perf-bot posted CI artifacts — link: https://ci.internal/reports/4247/flare-heap.html. flame shows long lock hold in arena_coalesce() around the kernel selection patch.

perf-bot: CI regression: perf/longctx p99 tokens +22%, memory RSS +18%. Suspected commits: 0f3a9b (kernel-routing tweak), a1b2c3 (compact-on-evict heuristic).

erin: thanks. @kevin can you try reverting the compact heuristic locally to confirm? if it reproduces, we should revert in prod.

kevin: did a revert patch locally (re-enable original eviction order). repro goes away, memory stabilizes, p99 returns to baseline. bisect pins it to a1b2c3.

sam: perfect — can we get a tiny repro snippet to run in CI? helps for a quick revert PR.

kevin: repro command: `./run_longctx --model small --seq 8192 --batch-mix 1,8,32 --iters 50` yields OOM in ~35s with compact-on-evict=1; with =0 it completes. Dump: ```
Assertion failed: arena_coalesce: double-free?
backtrace:
  runtime::kv::evict(...)
  runtime::kernel_select(...)
```

rachel: adding context: kernel-selection change made the runtime pick a per-seq kernel when > 2048; the compact heuristic assumed contiguous slab layout which no longer holds with per-seq packing. leads to fragmentation and thrash under mixed-batch workloads.

maria: proposed mitigation: 1) immediate revert of compact-on-evict heuristic (fast). 2) short-term: add metric for slab-fragmentation ratio + a CI longctx smoke test. 3) longer: redesign allocator to be per-kernel aware.

erin: agree. @sam can you open a revert PR and mark as rollout-blocker? include the repro and CI links. I'll ping infra for emergency deploy.

sam: on it, PR opened: https://git.redwood/infra/PR-4268 (revert a1b2c3). tagging release-candidate. cc @rachel for notes.

perf-bot: deploy candidate 2026-11-03T03:12 started. smoke-tests running.

kevin: post-rollback smoke looks clean locally. will watch prod metrics after deploy.

rachel: follow-up: we should add unit tests for mixed batch slab layout and a fuzz harness that varies seq-length distributions. added ticket INF-2193.

erin: thanks everyone. leaving this thread open until we see prod stable for 2 hours. :thumbsup:

sam: prod metrics look stable at +1h, no new OOMs. closing as resolved unless it resurfaces. :white_check_mark:
